partners.mechanism_chain: CFH (HGNC:1640) —DISRUPTS→ complement system activation (GO:0006955); complement system activation (GO:0006955) —LEADS_TO→ basal laminar drusen (MONDO:0007472); PROS1 (HGNC:9809) —DISRUPTS→ complement system activation (GO:0006955); complement system activation (GO:0006955) —LEADS_TO→ thrombophilia (MONDO:0013791). falsification.text: If genetic studies show that CFH and PROS1 variants do not converge on shared downstream effects within the complement system, or if experimental models demonstrate independent functional pathways that do not intersect, the proposed link would be falsified. Furthermore, the absence of PROS1 variants in individuals with basal laminar drusen, and CFH variants in individuals with thrombophilia (outside of known pleiotropy), would weaken the hypothesis.
falsification.gnomad_variant: The presence of common, benign variants in PROS1 (e.g., rs1063306 with AF > 0.01) would not falsify the hypothesis, as rare pathogenic variants are implicated. However, a common pathogenic variant in PROS1 associated with thrombophilia would challenge the model if it did not also show a link to drusen pathology.
